correctness.rationale: Every admissible finite word splits uniquely into independent dyadic golden-mean chain words. The recurrence for its exponential counting polynomial gives exact first and second moments. Chain-count errors bounded uniformly in each length, together with geometric tails, yield mean \(\alpha N+O((\log N)^2)\) and variance \(\sigma^2N+O((\log N)^3)\), with \(\sigma^2\ge1/16\). Lindeberg’s triangular-array theorem proves the asserted centered Gaussian law. Perron–Frobenius ratios establish fixed-cylinder convergence to the boundary-biased Parry-chain product. Its Markov recursion yields \(q_r\) and \(\beta=2/(4+\sqrt5)\); independent-chain Hoeffding plus Borel–Cantelli proves the latter almost surely. The first five positive terms in \(\alpha\) exceed \(1/3>\beta\), so the mid-gap frequency event gives the claimed exponential total-variation lower bound. The checker enumerates 18 exact finite-prefix horizons and tests the bounded-differences inequality for 1,999 finite volumes, but finite tests are not proofs of infinite limits.

originality.rationale: Originality is confined to the combined quantitative theorem for the uniform finite-prefix probability ensemble: explicit CLT, its local weak Parry-product limit, a different almost-sure global digit density of that limit and an exponential lower bound forcing asymptotically maximal finite-prefix total variation. The same-system Fibonacci chain decomposition and dimension formulas, standard Gaussian concentration machinery, and Parry transition construction are credited prior mathematics. Primary-source full-text and public mathematical-record comparisons found no implication covering the combined claim; an undiscovered general weighted-subshift result remains possible.
residual_risks: A general weighted multiplicative-subshift thermodynamic theorem not found in the inspected full texts could already imply the count CLT and local-limit comparison.
The exact Markov initial law and the beta digit-frequency formula are basic consequences of classical Perron theory and are not independently claimed as novel discoveries.
Novelty is best-knowledge within inspected accessible literature and published records; historical priority has not been independently certified.

value.rationale: The main object is a canonical multiplicative subshift in which finite-volume uniform sampling and the locally limiting infinite probability law are a natural comparison. The positive explicit gap between bulk and local-limit digit densities proves a nontrivial failure of exchanging volume and local observation scales, not merely a routine word count; exponential TV separation quantifies that failure despite cylinderwise convergence. The new Gaussian variance series describes macroscopic fluctuations in the genuinely uniform finite-prefix ensemble and gives reproducible statistical benchmarks for multiplicative symbolic systems. The work avoids claims about arbitrary multiplicative subshifts or universal fluctuation laws.
